instruction.text: Choose which idiom can be used here.

atoms.a: I don't have much time for the preparations today. Can we start with it now?
She promised me to be more responsible, but honestly I still believe she won't.
atoms.b: She promised me to be more responsible, but honestly, ((++a_leopard_can’t_change_its_spots she_puts_her_money_where_her_mouth_is)).

atoms.a: While many people enjoy swimming in the lake, I have to admit I don't really like it.
atoms.b: While many people enjoy swimming in the lake, ((++it's_not_my_cup_of_tea it's_not_a_piece_of_cake)).

atoms.a: He is running late to work because he always gossips with the neighbours when he leaves the house.
atoms.b: He is running late to work because he always ((++chews_the_fat bites_the_bullet)) with the neighbours when he leaves the house.

atoms.a: My sister is visiting me next weekend! I have already planned to which places we can go and we will do every single attraction!
atoms.b: My sister is visiting me next weekend! I have already planned to which places we can go and we will do ((++the_whole_nine_yards once_in_a_blue_moon))!

atoms.a: My friend always does everything possible to make my birthday special!
atoms.b: My friend always ((++goes_the_extra_mile bites_the_bullet)) to make my birthday special!

atoms.a: “Did you hear that Sam is in Sydney now?”, Owen asks. “Yes, and he moved there without having a job or an apartment.”, Ellen answers. “That's just like him, he always improvises.”, Owen says amused.
atoms.b: “Did you hear that Sam is in Sydney now?”, Owen asks. “Yes, and he moved there without having a job or an apartment.”, Ellen answers. “That's just like him, he always ((++plays_it_by_ear is_on_the_same_page)).”, Owen says amused.

atoms.a: I wish you luck for today!
